mapper.select: SELECT * FROM calendar_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM calendar_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM calendar_subscription WHERE enabled = 1 AND (last_refreshed_at IS NULL OR last_refreshed_at < #{cutoff}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_subscription (user_id, url, name, color, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{url}, #{name}, #{color}, #{enabled})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM calendar_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE calendar_subscription SET etag = #{etag}, last_modified = #{lastModified}, last_refreshed_at = #{refreshedAt}, last_error = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
UPDATE calendar_subscription SET last_error = #{error} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM calendar_event WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_event (user_id, kind, subscription_id, title, note, start_at, end_at, all_day, timezone, rrule, external_uid, recurrence_id) VALUES (#{userId}, 'ics', #{subscriptionId}, #{title}, #{note}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{allDay}, #{timezone}, #{rrule}, #{externalUid}, #{recurrenceId})
